newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Music sets 10 pct stock dividend.
newsitem.headline: Music sets 10 pct stock dividend.

text.p: Music Semiconductors Corp said on Wednesday its board had approved a 10 percent stock dividend.
The firm said in a statement the dividend would be taken from its additional paid-in capital as of end of December last year.
Music said it will hold a special meeting on June 2 to seek stockholders approval for the dividend proposal.
The company also needs approval from the Securities and Exchange Commission.
On Wednesday, Music Semiconductors was down 25 centavos to 14 pesos in late Manila trade.
